1. (Currently amended) A method of providing advertisements in a traffic message comprising: - obtaining traffic data having a traffic condition of a location description on a road network using a processor-based system; - assessing a location reference code associated with the location description assigned by a traffic message supplier using the processor-based system; - assessing an advertising reference code associated with the location reference code using the processor-based system; - determining whether the advertising reference code is present using the processor-based system; and - generating a traffic message having the location reference code and the advertising reference code when the advertising reference code is present using the processor-based system, wherein the traffic message is transmitted to a computer-readable medium for storage and broadcast.

2. (Currently amended) The method according to Claim 1 is implemented at server side of a traffic service network using a processor-based server system.

3. (Currently amended) The method according to Claim 1 further comprising: - generating a traffic message having the location reference code when the advertising reference code is not present using the processor-based system.

4. (Original) The method according to Claim 1 further comprising: - providing the traffic message for broadcast to navigation systems.

5. (Original) The method according to Claim 4, wherein the traffic message is broadcast using any one or more selected from a group of Radio Data System (RDS), Traffic Message Channel (TMC), Radio Data System-Traffic Message Channel (RDS-TMC), Vehicle Information and Communication System, digital radio, satellite radio, mobile Internet, mobile paging, and General Packet Radio Services/Global System for Mobile (GPRS/GSM) phone networks.

6. (Currently amended) The method according to Claim 1 further comprising, prior to assessing an advertising reference code associated with the location reference code: - determining whether the traffic message is a message of every predefined number of messages for broadcast using the processor-based system; and - generating a traffic message having the location reference code when the traffic message is a message of every predefined number of messages for broadcast using the processor-based system.

7. (Original) The method according to Claim 1, wherein the predefined number of messages is based, at least in part, on any one or more selected from a group of a predefined time duration, every 10th message, every 50th message, every 100th message, a range of every 10th to 25th message, a range of every 50th to 65th message, and a range of every 100th to 150th message.

8. (Original) The method according to Claim 1, wherein the traffic message uses any one or more selected from a group of an Alert-C protocol, Alert-Plus protocol, packet-based protocol, and Vehicle Information and Communication System message protocol.

9. (Original) The method according to Claim 1, wherein the location reference code comprises any one or more selected from a group of a geographic location, a point of interest, a local location of a geographic location.

10. (Original) The method according to Claim 1, wherein the advertising reference code comprises any one or more selected from a group of resource codes representing at least a portion of an advertisement and a substantially unique code identifying at least a portion of an advertisement stored on a recipient device of the traffic message.

11. (Currently amended) The method according to Claim 1, wherein assessing an advertising reference code associated with the location reference code further comprises: - assessing a current time using the processor-based system; - assessing the advertising reference code based, at least in part, on the current time using the processor-based system.

12. (Currently amended) A computer-readable medium having executable instructions stored thereon for performing the method of Claim 1 on a processor-based system.

13. (Currently amended) An apparatus having a processor and executable instructions stored thereon for performing the method of Claim 1, wherein the apparatus comprises a processor-based system configured to execute the method steps.

14. (Currently amended) A method of providing advertisement messages using location reference codes comprising: - assessing a location reference code of a location description using a processor-based system; - assessing an advertising reference code associated with the location reference code using the processor-based system; - generating an advertising message having the advertising reference code using the processor-based system; and - providing the advertising message for broadcast to navigation systems using the processor-based system, wherein the advertising message is transmitted to a computer-readable medium for storage and broadcast.

15. (Currently amended) The method according to Claim 14 is implemented at server side of a traffic service network using a processor-based server system.

16. (Currently amended) The method according to Claim 14, wherein the advertising messages are sent every predefined number of messages for broadcast using the processor-based system.

17. (Original) The method according to Claim 16, wherein the predefined number of messages is based, at least in part, on any one or more selected from a group of a predefined time duration, every 10th message, every 50th message, every 100th message, a range of every 10th to 25th message, a range of every 50th to 65th message, and a range of every 100th to 150th message.

18. (Original) The method according to Claim 14, wherein the advertising message is broadcast using any one or more selected from a group of Radio Data System (RDS), Traffic Message Channel (TMC), Radio Data System-Traffic Message Channel (RDS-TMC), Vehicle Information and Communication System, digital radio, satellite radio, mobile Internet, mobile paging, and General Packet Radio Services/Global System for Mobile (GPRS/GSM) phone networks.

19. (Original) The method according to Claim 14, wherein the traffic message uses any one or more selected from a group of an Alert-C protocol, Alert-Plus protocol, packet-based protocol, and Vehicle Information and Communication System message protocol.

20. (Original) The method according to Claim 14, wherein the location reference code comprises any one or more selected from a group of a geographic location, a point of interest, a local location of a geographic location.

21. (Original) The method according to Claim 14, wherein the advertising reference code comprises any one or more selected from a group of resource codes representing at least a portion of an advertisement and a substantially unique code identifying at least a portion of an advertisement stored on a recipient device of the advertising message.

22. (Currently amended) The method according to Claim 14, wherein assessing an advertising reference code associated with the location reference code further comprises: - assessing a current time using the processor-based system; - assessing the advertising reference code based, at least in part, on the current time using the processor-based system.

23. (Currently amended) A computer-readable medium having executable instructions stored thereon for performing the method of Claim 14 on a processor-based system.

24. (Currently amended) An apparatus having a processor and executable instructions stored thereon for performing the method of Claim 14, wherein the apparatus comprises a processor-based system configured to execute the method steps.

25. (Currently amended) A method of providing advertisements comprising: - generating a message having an advertising reference code using a processor-based system; and - providing the message for broadcast to navigation systems using the processor-based system, wherein the advertising reference code comprises a substantially unique code that identifies at least a portion of an advertisement stored and displayed on a recipient device of the message, and wherein the message is transmitted to a computer-readable medium for storage and broadcast.

26. (Currently amended) The method according to Claim 25 is implemented at server side of a traffic service network using a processor-based server system.

27. (Currently amended) A method of providing advertisements via a traffic channel comprising: - generating a message having advertisements using a processor-based system; and - serially transmitting the message for broadcast to navigation systems via the traffic channel using the processor-based system.

28. (Currently amended) The method according to Claim 27 is implemented at server side of a traffic service network using a processor-based server system.

29. (Currently amended) A method of providing advertisements using location reference codes comprising: - receiving a message from a traffic supplier using a processor-based system, wherein the message contains a location reference and an advertising reference code; - assessing at least one advertisement associated with the advertising reference code using the processor-based system; and - presenting the at least one advertisement to a user of the navigation system at a location based on the location reference code using the processor-based system.

30. (Currently amended) The method according to Claim 29 is implemented at client side of a traffic service network using a processor-based client system.

31. (Currently amended) The method according to Claim 29 further comprising: - determining whether traffic data is present from message using the processor-based system; - assessing a location description based, at least in part, on the location reference code using the processor-based system; - assessing traffic data from the message associated with the location description using the processor-based system; and - presenting the at least one advertisement along with the traffic data advertisement to a user of the navigation system using the processor-based system.

32. (Original) The method according to Claim 29, wherein the at least one advertisement is any one or more selected from a group of an audio output, an video output, an icon output, and a text output.

39. (Currently amended) An apparatus of providing advertisements using location reference codes comprising: - a memory coupled to a processor, the memory having a message with a location reference code and an advertising reference code; - an advertising provider coupled to the memory and the processor, wherein the advertising provider assesses at least one advertisement associated with the advertising reference code; and - a user interface coupled to the advertising provider and the processor, wherein the user interface provides the at least one advertisement associated with the advertising reference code for output on a navigation system.

40. (Currently amended) The apparatus according to Claim 39 further comprising: - a traffic reporter coupled to the user interface and the processor, wherein the traffic reporter assesses traffic information associated with the location reference code provided by the user interface.

41. 42. (Currently amended) A memory comprising a data structure of traffic message stored on a computer-readable medium, wherein the data structure comprises: a first field having a location reference code associated with a location description on a road segment assigned by a traffic message supplier; and a second field having an advertising reference code associated with the location reference of the first field, wherein the advertising reference code is associated with at least one advertisement for output on a navigation system.
